title: VARS1 overexpression in hepatocellular carcinoma cell lines
projectDescription: VARS1 was transiently overexpressed in Hep3B and SNU-387 hepatocellular carcinoma-derived cell lines.
sampleProcessingProtocol: RIPA lysis buffer complemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors was used por protein extraction in Hep3B and SNU-387 VARS1-overexpressing cell lines. Samples were analysed by LC-MS/MS [DIA-PASEF mode (“short gradient”), EvosepOne/timsTOFFleX Clinical Proteomics Platform IMSMI].
dataProcessingProtocol: Peptides and proteins were identified and quantified by machine learning using DIANN software
